news.headline: Bot Traffic Will Be “1000X” Bigger Than Human Traffic in Just Five Years, According to Cloudflare CEO
news.summary: Key TakeawaysCloudflare CEO Matthew Prince says automated traffic could become 1,000 times human traffic within five years if current trends continue. More than 20% of the web sits behind Cloudflare’s network, putting the company in the path of rising AI-agent and bot traffic.

news.headline: Cloudflare and Deutsche Telekom Join Forces for a Secure and Resilient Internet
news.summary: BONN, Germany & SAN FRANCISCO, September 29, 2026--Deutsche Telekom AG (XETRA:DTE) and Cloudflare, Inc.
